evidence.quote: Go to studio.reducto.ai and sign up for a free account.
The hosted server runs at https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp, and you can add this to your MCP client config by replacing your-api-key with a key from studio.reducto.ai/api-keys.
Go to studio.reducto.ai and sign up for a free account.

result.notes: Self-serve free account at studio.reducto.ai grants an API key immediately (bearer token auth), with $150 free usage credit before paid rates ($10/1k pages parse, $20/1k pages extract) apply. REST API is small (~18 paths) covering parse/extract/split/edit/classify/pipeline plus job/upload management. Official vendor-published MCP server (reductoai/mcp-server-reducto) is hosted at mcp.reducto.ai and uses the same API key. Higher tiers (Growth/Enterprise) require sales contact but are not needed for basic agent-toolkit buildability.
result.one_liner: Reducto is a document parsing/extraction API that converts PDFs and complex documents into structured, LLM-ready data.
